records.summary_text:
[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 27 August 2026.

[2026-08-27_SOL]  
Video Title: When to Accumulate Solana $SOL  
Video ID: 8OcJhw2jdjk  
Solana (SOL) | Class: CRYPTO  

    Current Structure:  
    • The current trading price sits around $103 on the weekly average, positioned above the 20‑week SMA of $81 but below the 200‑week SMA of $110.  
    • Composite risk is measured at 15/100, with a macro risk level of 37%, indicating moderate volatility relative to peers.  
    • Over the last 90 days, SOL has gained 25% and holds a gem score of 75/100, placing it in the “golden zone” of low risk and high return.  
    • Social sentiment wordcloud momentum shows a surge in “accumulation” and “bullish” tags, reflecting growing investor optimism.  

    Macro Quantitative Risk:  
    • TWAP baseline is anchored at the fair value of $81, with the current price at $101, slightly above fair value.  
    • TWAP risk level is at level 2, suggesting the market has moved beyond a bear‑market low and into a bullish expansion phase.  
    • Regression fair‑value bands place SOL within a one‑standard‑deviation bull channel between $81 and $156, while a two‑standard‑deviation polynomial regression channel extends to about $165.  
    • Undervaluation residuals are minimal; the price is only 17% above the lifetime average of $86, indicating a modest premium rather than overvaluation.  

    Downside & Upside Targets:  
    • Machine‑learning forecast models project a floor near $75 if a short‑term downturn occurs, with a base case target around $120.  
    • The bull case ranges from $116 to $174, while a rare high scenario could push SOL to the $570 ceiling, with a peak zone near $295 and an extreme euphoria peak at $527.  
    • Panic‑drawdown support floors are estimated at $55, reflecting a 400‑day bear‑market scenario that is roughly 80% complete.  
    • Macro moving‑average supports include the 200‑week SMA of $110 and the 20‑week SMA of $81, both acting as dynamic resistance and support levels.  
    • Cycle bull targets for late 2029 to early 2030 project a range of $450 to $600, representing a 4‑ to 6‑fold increase over the current price.
